newsitem.title: USA: Sysco Corp completes 6 mln share buyback.
newsitem.headline: Sysco Corp completes 6 mln share buyback.

text.p: Sysco Corp said Friday it has completed its 1996 six million share buyback program at a total cost of $198.2 million.
The company said it has also repurchased 250,000 shares under its 1997 stock repurchase program, which will also buy back six million shares in total.
In a press release, Sysco President Bill Lindig said the company will re-examine annually an increased level of share repurchases.
He also said that from now on the company will stop its practice of imposing a blackout period preventing the company from buying its own shares on the dates that its financial results are released.
